[RDSC.5a.7g.1] The `SeriesBackendReservoir` atom declares a uniform-random reservoir of
size `n` over all-time history — the backing for the `sample <n>` time
model ([LSMP.5]). State is O(`n`), independent of stream length. It serves the
bag aggregations `mean` / `stdev` / `pstdev` / `variance` / `pvariance` / `min` /
`max` / `sum` / `count` / `median` / `pXX` / `bool_and` / `bool_or`.
